+ /**

+  * @param question The natural language question to ask

+ export async function askKeyFigures(

+ /**
+  * Aggregate key figures by specified fields
+  * @param aggregateBy Field to aggregate by
+  * @param measure Field to measure
+  * @param operation Aggregation operation to perform
+  * @param filter Optional filter to apply before aggregation
+  * @returns Aggregated data grouped by the specified field
+  */
+ export async function aggregateKeyFigures(
+ 	aggregateBy: string,
+ 	measure: string,
+ 	operation: "sum" | "average" | "count" | "min" | "max",
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;,
+ ): Promise&lt;Record&lt;string, number&gt;&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		let query = xata.db.personnel;
+ 
+ 		if (filter) {
+ 			query = query.filter(filter);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const records = await query.getMany();
+ 
+ 		// Calculate aggregations
+ 		const result: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {};
+ 		const groups: Record&lt;string, number[]&gt; = {};
+ 
+ 		// Group values by aggregateBy field
+ 		records.forEach((record) =&gt; {
+ 			const groupKey = String(record[aggregateBy] || "undefined");
+ 			const value = Number(record[measure] || 0);
+ 
+ 			if (!groups[groupKey]) {
+ 				groups[groupKey] = [];
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			groups[groupKey].push(value);
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Apply the requested operation to each group
+ 		for (const [key, values] of Object.entries(groups)) {
+ 			switch (operation) {
+ 				case "sum":
+ 					result[key] = values.reduce((sum, value) =&gt; sum + value, 0);
+ 					break;
+ 				case "average":
+ 					result[key] =
+ 						values.reduce((sum, value) =&gt; sum + value, 0) / values.length;
+ 					break;
+ 				case "count":
+ 					result[key] = values.length;
+ 					break;
+ 				case "min":
+ 					result[key] = Math.min(...values);
+ 					break;
+ 				case "max":
+ 					result[key] = Math.max(...values);
+ 					break;
+ 			}
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		return result;
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error(&#96;Error aggregating key figures by ${aggregateBy}:&#96;, error);
+ 		throw error;
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Filter key figures based on complex criteria
+  * @param criteria Object containing filter criteria
+  * @param options Additional options for filtering
+  * @returns Filtered key figure records
+  */
+ export async function filterKeyFigures(
+ 	criteria: {
+ 		[key: string]: any;
+ 		dateRange?: { field: string; start: Date; end: Date };
+ 		textSearch?: { fields: string[]; query: string };
+ 		numericRange?: { field: string; min?: number; max?: number };
+ 	},
+ 	options?: {
+ 		sortBy?: { field: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" };
+ 		limit?: number;
+ 		offset?: number;
+ 		includeFields?: string[];
+ 	},
+ ): Promise&lt;PersonnelRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		let query = xata.db.personnel;
+ 
+ 		// Apply basic filter criteria (exact matches)
+ 		const basicCriteria: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = { ...criteria };
+ 		delete basicCriteria.dateRange;
+ 		delete basicCriteria.textSearch;
+ 		delete basicCriteria.numericRange;
+ 
+ 		if (Object.keys(basicCriteria).length &gt; 0) {
+ 			query = query.filter(basicCriteria);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply date range filter if specified
+ 		if (criteria.dateRange) {
+ 			const { field, start, end } = criteria.dateRange;
+ 			query = query.filter({
+ 				[field]: {
+ 					$ge: start,
+ 					$le: end,
+ 				},
+ 			});
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply numeric range filter if specified
+ 		if (criteria.numericRange) {
+ 			const { field, min, max } = criteria.numericRange;
+ 			const rangeFilter: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};
+ 
+ 			if (min !== undefined) {
+ 				rangeFilter.$ge = min;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			if (max !== undefined) {
+ 				rangeFilter.$le = max;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			if (Object.keys(rangeFilter).length &gt; 0) {
+ 				query = query.filter({
+ 					[field]: rangeFilter,
+ 				});
+ 			}
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply text search if specified
+ 		if (criteria.textSearch) {
+ 			// Note: This is a simplified implementation
+ 			// Xata may have better ways to handle complex text searches
+ 			const { fields, query: searchQuery } = criteria.textSearch;
+ 			const textResults = await xata.db.personnel.search(searchQuery, {
+ 				fuzziness: 1,
+ 				target: fields,
+ 			});
+ 
+ 			// Extract IDs from search results for filtering
+ 			const matchingIds = textResults.records.map((record) =&gt; record.id);
+ 			if (matchingIds.length &gt; 0) {
+ 				query = query.filter({
+ 					id: { $any: matchingIds },
+ 				});
+ 			} else {
+ 				// No text matches found, return empty array
+ 				return [];
+ 			}
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply sorting if specified
+ 		if (options?.sortBy) {
+ 			query = query.sort(options.sortBy.field, options.sortBy.direction);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply field selection if specified
+ 		if (options?.includeFields) {
+ 			query = query.select(options.includeFields);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Apply pagination if specified
+ 		if (options?.limit !== undefined) {
+ 			const paginationOptions = {
+ 				pagination: {
+ 					size: options.limit,
+ 					offset: options.offset || 0,
+ 				},
+ 			};
+ 
+ 			return (await query.getPaginated(paginationOptions)).records;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Otherwise, return all matching records
+ 		return await query.getMany();
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error filtering key figures:", error);
+ 		throw error;
+ 	}
+ }
